post.description: Validates the graph, input and options, then creates a `queued` run. 202 Accepted: the run executes asynchronously; poll `Location`.

R1.4. `approve` re-queues the run with the decision (and optional edited tool arguments); `reject` cancels it with reason `rejected`. Works with no worker alive. 409 unless the run is `waiting_approval`.
post.summary: Approve or reject a paused run (human-in-the-loop)

post.description: A queued or waiting run is cancelled now; a running run stops before its next node (R1.6). 409 if the run has already ended.
Re-sends work for a queued run or one whose worker died; does nothing for a run a live worker is executing (R1.3). 409 if the run has already ended.

get.description: Replays persisted events after `Last-Event-ID` (or `after_seq`), then streams live ones from any replica (R2.5). Persisted events carry `id: <seq>`. A `: ping` comment is sent when idle; the stream closes after the run's terminal event; on replica shutdown an `event: reconnect` tells the client to reconnect with its Last-Event-ID.
